# SJ Tours and Travels
> Travel agency in Ambur, Tirupattur district, Tamil Nadu, India. We plan Jain tirth yatra (Nakoda Ji, Ambaji, Osian, Khetlaji), Tirumala darshan trips, holidays abroad (Dubai, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Vietnam), flights and visa help. Jain vegetarian food is planned on request. Not affiliated with sjtravels.in.

Address: 85/T Bypass Road, Ambur, Tamil Nadu 635802. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 95669 77211. Founder: Shenick Jain.

The published site also shows hello@sjtravel.in. Office hours, a map pin, registration numbers and a Google Business Profile link are not confirmed on this page.
